description: National Formal Rest Areas is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (DITRDCSA). Regular stops and the opportunity for rest breaks are essential for safe driving, and formal rest areas are provided to help drivers manage fatigue and comply with driving hours regulations (by providing an opportunity for sleep and rest breaks). Information on rest area locations and facilities is sourced from open data that state and territory governments publish. Coverage is Australia, 2019 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2026-09-29. Files and pages listed: API, CSV, PDF (3 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
